questionText: Around 34% of registered voters in the U.S identify as independents, according to 2022 electorate data. Using the Binomial model, what is the probability of observing at most 125 independents in a random sample of 400 registered voters? Enter your answer as a fraction rounded to two decimal places (e.g., eighty-eight percent = 0.88).
questionHtml:
Around 34% of registered voters in the U.S identify as independents, according to 2022 electorate data. Using the Binomial model, what is the probability of observing at most 125 independents in a random sample of 400 registered voters?

Enter your answer as a fraction rounded to two decimal places (e.g., eighty-eight percent = 0.88).
